messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy v2.14.0 to prod started on cluster-prod (rolling) :rocket:
raj: saw alerts for increased 5xx/timeouts on inference-gateway, paging in case oncall is awake :rotating_light:
alyssa: i'm awake, looking at dashboards now. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~1.8s across the cluster, p99 ~7s. 5xxs are gateway 502/504 and some model backend 5xxs
sophia: loading tail logs. any release notes with network or connection changes in this deploy?
deploy-bot: release v2.14.0 includes multiplexing changes to connection pooling and a retry backoff tweak
raj: ok that tracks. can someone grab the canary nodes metrics first? maybe a bad rollout fraction?
alyssa: canary looks okay (10% traffic), canary p95 ~140ms. problem appears after cutover to 60% traffic at 6312345692
ops-bot: Pager duty: esk-ops oncall acknowledged by raj
raj: i'm going to pause rollout and scale down the new revision. triggering rollback if rollback is fast. @sophia can you reproduce the spike on a single instance with a load test?
sophia: running synthetic hit against model-prod/replica-7 now. observing request queue climbing and request latency spike. KCACHE miss rate also up ~25%
alyssa: kv cache eviction logs show padding change applied in v2.14.0, might be causing cache churn under load
infra-lead: looking at network logs — no cluster-wide network flaps. connection counts increased from ~2k to ~18k after cutover on worker nodes
raj: agreed risk looks high. starting immediate rollback to v2.13.9. issuing rollout abort and revert in k8s:

```
# abort current rollout and set image to previous
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/inference-gateway inference-gateway=redwood/inference:2.13.9
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-gateway -n inference
```

ops-bot: Rollback command issued by raj at 6312345705, rollout initiated
sophia: watching for drain/eviction. please hold customer-facing escalations until rollback completes
alyssa: telemetry: p95 starting to drop on canary immediately, main fleet still elevated — expecting gradual fall as old pods scale back in
customer-success: heads-up: we've got 3 incoming tickets from enterprise customers hitting 500s, triage underway. i'll update CSE channel with customer IDs once we have more detail
raj: adding mitigation notes to incident doc: rollback due to kv cache padding change causing request queuing/latency. fallback plan: pin rollout to 2.13.x and revert multiplexing flags until we have a test for cache churn
infra-lead: nodes are stabilizing, connection queues decreasing. by 6312345720 p95 ~210ms, p99 ~500ms and trending down
sophia: can we block automatic rollout for this repo until we have a postmortem? set rule in CI to require perf smoke for cache-affecting changes
alyssa: opened internal ticket ID INF-1249 and linked perf checklist
raj: good. placing this incident on watch for next 2 hours. paging rotation: raj -> alyssa -> sophia for monitoring. if any customer impact >5 customers escalate to director oncall
customer-success: will send patch notes to affected customers and offer extended support window. recording impact and ETA in the incident doc
ops-bot: Incident closed to active mitigation at 6312345724 (rollback in progress, no further immediate action).
_meta: generated for dataset: simulated slack incident thread about deploy-induced timeout regression and rollback; messages are synthetic but realistic
